title: Graffiti Wall
intro: Create a shared classroom display of what makes a strong teammate.

blocks.text: Choose one slip size and print one slip per student. These printouts are separate from the Print Pack.

items.title: Show
items.text: Display Slide 8 to introduce the Graffiti Wall.

items.title: Respond
items.text: Students complete “A strong teammate is someone who…” on their slips.

items.title: Display
items.text: Collect and display the responses together as a class Graffiti Wall.

source_note: Optional More Time? You Chewz! activity from Part 04, lesson-local Slide 8 and original student-facing Bulletin Board slips. Shared teacher companion masthead and layout. Release dependency refresh: student printouts verified in official Drive.
